Already played?
[Not an option.]
posts.lead: If a bench player's game already kicked off, his slot is locked. AllFantasy leaves him out of your swap tips, so every suggestion is a move you can actually make.

caption.instagram:

If your bench guy played Thursday night, he can't come in on Sunday. AllFantasy knows that, so he never shows up in your swap tips. Every suggestion is a move you can actually make.

posts.lead: Example: your RB1 is out and your bench has no healthy RB. AllFantasy still finds a move.

caption.instagram:
No healthy RB on your bench? You might still have a move. 🔁

AllFantasy's swap tips check your flex spots: slide your flex RB into the open RB slot, then fill the flex with your best WR or TE. If the bench is empty, it points you to a free agent.

Link in bio.
